gen-gf-gabarito-gf-science-gothic: Gabarito draws every letter as if with a single nib, its open-cut terminals letting the counters flow outward, while Science Gothic follows in a sans with far-apart stroke ends. Body text at a modest size suits it.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-syncopate: Loose, inked, a bit quirky: Gabarito looks hand-drawn with one nib, its cut-open terminals spilling the counters outward. Syncopate takes over with the technical-pen steadiness of a sans-serif, spacing its letters like rungs on a rope ladder, so the heading does the showing and the body does the steady telling.
gen-gf-gabarito-manrope: Gabarito's terminals are cut open so its counters flow outward, giving the heading a drawn-with-one-nib personality. And Manrope, a sans-serif with bright gaps at every curve and a taller lowercase, handles the quieter work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-gabarito-montserrat: Montserrat reads like a line of wire gliding under the eye, with generous white space leading into each curve and oversized counters in its e and a. Beside Gabarito's expressive heading, that openness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-gabarito-satoshi: Gabarito leads with an expressive, one-nib look, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. And Satoshi, a sans-serif with a soaring x-height and a wide e that never squeezes shut, gives the pair its strongest quality: a friendly, unfussy readability.
gen-gf-gabarito-switzer: Playful ink, open-mouthed curves: Gabarito looks drawn with one nib, its terminals cut so the counters flow outward. Switzer then carries a longer read in tubular, wire-like sans letters, with a tall waist line and c tips that never creep toward touching.
gen-gf-gabarito-work-sans: Work Sans has a contemporary feel, with a high mean line and c tips that never creep toward touching, all in a sans-serif frame. And Gabarito, drawn with one nib and open-cut terminals, gives the pair its distinctive edge up top.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-abeezee: Wide, bold and a little techy: Goldman spreads its round forms like open parentheses, with a big lowercase against its capitals. ABeeZee follows in a sans-serif of rounded-nib strokes, terminals finishing well clear of the stem, so the heading shouts and the text simply talks.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-aldrich: Goldman's widely set letters give generous clearance, and its round forms curve like open parentheses. Aldrich, a sans with a marker-like line, makes a longer read feel like tracing one thick thread.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-alexandria: Commanding up top, Goldman spreads its round forms like open parentheses with wide clearance between letters. But Alexandria, a sans with wide open c terminals and a tall body with short stems, makes a longer stretch of text read clean and professional.
